text: The scanty wisdom of man, on entering into an affair which looks well at first, cannot discern the poison that is hidden in it... if he who rules a principality cannot recognize evils until they are upon him, he is not truly wise; and this insight is given to few.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIII, Concerning auxiliaries, mixed soldiery, and one's own
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
